author: Ankit
problem: Given a list of sensor readings, count the stretches of identical consecutive readings that are at least min_len long.
bug_description: The final run is never appended after the loop, so a stretch that reaches the end of the list is not counted.

comments.accurate: Counts runs of equal consecutive readings whose length is at least min_len
comments.wrong_behavior: Counts runs of equal readings of length >= min_len; the trailing run is still open and not counted
comments.wrong_location: Run splitting verified; check the min_len filter for off-by-one
